trueskill/ is a copy of the "trueskill" Python package, version 0.4.5
(https://github.com/sublee/trueskill, BSD licence, see trueskill/LICENSE.txt),
with the Python 2 "six" imports removed. It is included because the package
no longer installs with current Python tooling.

Note from its authors: TrueSkill(TM) is a Microsoft brand; Microsoft permits
only Xbox Live games or non-commercial projects to use TrueSkill. This
project is non-commercial.
